title: It was Bloom gave the ideas for Sinn Fein to Griffith
html_source: Arthur Griffith, founder of the left-wing nationalist political party Sinn Féin, wrote an early article called “The Resurrection of Hungary” (1904) which was an account of civil disobedience and resistance by Hungarians to the ruling Austrian empire. This served as a template for his party to follow, outlining its fundamental principles. Bloom is of Hungarian ancestry, hence the link.
